blocks.text: The annual college entrance exam is underway in South Korea Thursday as authorities make all-out efforts to crack down on cheating involving smart devices and artificial intelligence. The College Scholastic Ability Test, one of the nation’s most important academic events, began at 8:40 a.m. at 1,312 test centers across the country and is scheduled to run until 5:45 p.m. A total of 551,864 people have applied for this year’s exam, with authorities deploying some 75,000 proctors and around 8,400 additional personnel to catch cheaters across test centers nationwide.
